ticket.title: Harmonize TypeScript wire contracts with Rust domain models in benchwork
ticket.description:
Polyglot contract drift detected by miter contracts across Rust models and TypeScript interfaces for AnonymizedSynthesisTrace, DadoPattern, TypedHole, TaskEdge, ChatMessage, and RoleOverrideConfig.

RE-CHECKED 2026-11-12: miter contracts reports Entities with Contract Drift: 0, one declared non-mirror, ALL CONTRACTS CONSISTENT across the Rust models and TypeScript interfaces this ticket named. Closing on that measurement.

verification_receipt.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace && miter audit --path . --threshold 250 --paths && chalkline docs check -d benchwork
